content.short: TrueFi enables collateral-free DeFi lending via an automated, market-driven credit rating and lending protocol.
content.description: TrueFi offers a truly collateral-free approach to decentralized lending, replacing conventional collateral with an automated, market-driven credit rating and lending protocol. Borrowers can exit at any time, and the system provides transparent, publicly verified and legally-bound borrowing along with competitive returns for lenders. The governance token TRU lets holders steer the protocol, approve borrowers, and influence treasury and partnership decisions, aligning governance with the community’s interests.
